description: This file defines the Address controller class within the Opencart admin module for managing customer addresses. It includes methods for displaying address lists, address forms, saving, deleting, and retrieving address data through JSON responses.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer addresses in the admin panel, including viewing, editing, deleting, and forming addresses.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the customer language and displays the list of addresses by rendering the address_list view.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves addresses for a specific customer and returns a rendered view with address data.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares and displays the address form for adding or editing a customer address.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of address data, performing validation, and updating the database via the model.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified address after permission and existence checks.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Returns address details as JSON, typically for AJAX requests.
